text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 206S-E08LE3 Heavy Duty Padlock with 5/16" Diameter Shackle and 4 Inch Clearance

The MUL-T-LOCK E-Series heavy duty padlocks are designed to offer the highest level of padlock protection available in the market today. All E-Series padlocks are made of Boron Alloy, and can withstand the most determined attempts of physical abuse. When looking for the Ultimate in High Security Padlock Protection, MUL-T-LOCK'S E-Series line of padlocks is your answer.

MUL-T-LOCK's high security locks are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

The shackle is locked with a double ball bearing mechanism. 90 degree key rotation unlocks the padlock.

Features for Mul-T-Lock E08LE3 Heavy Duty Extra Long Shackle Padlock

  • 5/16" Diameter Hardened Boron Alloy Shackle
  • Hardened Boron Alloy Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock E08LE3 Heavy Duty Extra Long Shackle Padlock

  • Shackle Diameter: 5/16" (8mm)
  • Total Height: 6-5/16" (160mm)
  • Total Width: 2-1/16" (52mm)
  • Total Thickness: 1-1/4" (33mm)
  • Clearance: 4" (102mm)
  • Standard Grades: "CEN" 4 ; "ASTM" 3
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK E08LE3 Padlock Specifications Diagram (PDF)

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.
